item.title: Iran says peace deal voided, fighting ‘existential war’ after US attacks

item.description: Ukraine released video of strikes on 20 Russian vessels in the Black Sea, including 17 oil tankers.

item.title: Iran unveils huge billboard showing Trump in coffin
item.description: Iran has installed a billboard in the capital Tehran showing US President Donald Trump lying in a coffin.

item.title: US launches fresh strikes on Iran as Trump warns Tehran it 'better behave'
item.description: US President Donald Trump says he is yet to decide whether or not he will "finish off" Iran.

item.description: Civilian casualties are reported in a number of Ukrainian regions, while Kyiv hits 20 Russian vessels in the Black Sea.

item.title: China economic growth falls sharply, missing target
item.description: Weak demand domestically and the impact of the Iran war on oil prices overshadowed the country's strong exports.

item.title: Air India crash report likely to be ready in October, say investigators
item.description: The crash killed 260 people, including 241 on board, with only one passenger surviving.

item.title: Seven Britons among those killed in Spain wildfires
item.description: Twelve of the 13 victims were foreign nationals, Spanish authorities said on Tuesday.
